t: Introduction and overview — Shelby Daytona Coupe (1964-1965)

title: Introduction and overview — Shelby Daytona Coupe (1964-1965)
description: Introduction and overview of the Shelby Daytona Coupe (1964-1965): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Shelby Daytona Coupe took the Cobra's 289 V8 and added Peter Brock's aerodynamic coupe body to beat Ferrari at Le Mans — winning the 1965 World Sportscar Championship, the only American car ever to do so. Only six were built; one sold for over $7 million, a record for an American car. Baseline facts: American racer 1964-1965; 6 built by Shelby; 1965 World Sportscar champions..
